## Verification run in this slice, in the foreground

**The gate, before the first source commit** — `tools/check.sh --part k/4`, four bounded
foreground calls, **all four green**: 288 / 287 / 288 / 287 steps, none red
(503 s / 420 s / 318 s / 391 s). No step stood on a banked reading — numpy, scipy,
Pillow, pyproj, jsonschema, openpyxl and pypdf are all installed on this runner, and the
only "not installed" lines in the transcripts are the tagged self-test proving that
warning fires. Preflight's other two questions answered separately (`check.sh` whole does
not fit the 600 s ceiling): `check-changelog-entry.mjs` against merge base `75cd3593` —
entry present; `resolve_id_collisions.mjs --check` — not applicable, tickets are their own
repo.

**Native build** — pinned Blender 4.5.3 on Ubuntu 26.04.1, tarball sha256 verified against
`generators/blender.pin` before use. 82 log_dwelling masters in four bounded batches
(2.7 / 2.8 / 2.7 / 2.7 s), `stale_derivatives.py` → `web_derivatives.sh --only` (18.3 s),
`compile_scene.py --all`, `generate_entrances.py`, `publish.sh` (71 s). **81 of 82 masters
byte-identical**; one moved, Cobweb's, with its one derivative. Hashes in the PR body.

**Smoke, by the parts that cover the diff** (`smoke_budget.mjs --for-diff`), each a bounded
foreground call redirected to a file:

| leg | result |
|---|---|
| `SMOKE_VIEWPORT=mobile SMOKE_STAGE=3-4 … --published` | **SMOKE PASS** — 139 passed, 0 failed, 7 m 22 s |
| `SMOKE_VIEWPORT=desktop SMOKE_STAGE=3 … --published` | **SMOKE PASS** — 107 passed, 0 failed, 7 m 16 s |

Stage 3 is the leg `--for-diff` names for the record's own account on the card, the source
sidecars and the liberties — the parts of this diff that are not the mesh itself. Zero page
errors on both.

**Application review, both release viewports, published mirror, default 1835.** I drove the
published tree and looked at the pixels myself, standing on the bank in front of the house:

- **desktop 1280×800 dpr 1** — the centre gable carries TWO upright dark apertures standing
  on the ground, in sawn casings with their reveals, and ONE small dark mark up in the
  gable. The old centred door is gone. Both wings keep their single window; the two
  outer-wing stacks, the roofs and the massing are unchanged. The HUD names the building
  (`Indian Agency House · 30 ft`) and the grounded entrance reads on the front.
- **phone 390×780 dpr 2** — the same three marks, the same two wing windows, the same
  massing.
- **Zero page errors, zero console errors, zero failed or ≥400 requests, zero server 404s**
  at both viewports.

That arrangement is what the panorama draws: the two lower marks in the face's left and
middle with the right-hand stretch left blank, and the upper mark a little left of the
apex.

**What this is not.** The camera on that panorama is still UNSOLVED and is not enrolled in
`data/reference_views/`; no `matches` verdict, no grade change, no completion. The
compound's width, the wings and sub-roofs, the roof junctions, the clapboarding and the
finish still differ. T-2374 stays open and is released back to the queue with those
differences recorded.

## The striping is repaired, and this is what was actually run for it

Picking up this same PR under the exact-resume rules. Ownership was verified fresh before
any write: PR #1690 open on `dev` with head `e9d93bf38…`, label `resume`, no `hold`;
T-2374 `open` with `claimed_by: null` and `pr: null`; `ticket.mjs inflight` showing this
branch with **no lap lock**; `ticket.mjs claims` holding no lap lock for 1690; and the
previous worker, polecat-platform run 41746386858, `completed` / `failure` (max turns) at
02:38:37Z. No live owner. Claimed through the ordinary protocol, branch retained, history
preserved — no reset, no replacement PR.

### The defect, and the one-expression repair

[The fixed-camera review](https://github.com/kevinrhaas/chicago/pull/1690#issuecomment-6621239185)
was right, and the cause is exactly as it stated. `openings.face(b, w, n, …)` measures `n`
out from the wall's **plane**; `openings.surround(…, back=k)` runs its reveal back to
`w.skin + k`. `_compound_aperture` handed the face the bare `APERTURE_BACK_M` (0.004 m)
while giving the surround the same constant as `back`, so the reveal ended at 0.026 m and
the dark face sat at 0.004 m — **behind** the 0.022 m the log courses stand proud. Both
grounded apertures were therefore crossed by horizontal courses.

```
-    openings.face(b, w, APERTURE_BACK_M, u0, u1, z0, z1, conf, M_DARK)
+    openings.face(b, w, w.skin + APERTURE_BACK_M, u0, u1, z0, z1, conf, M_DARK)
```

That is the convention the same file's blind doorway already follows (`back = -0.30 -
w.skin` beside `face(…, -0.30, …)`), and what `APERTURE_BACK_M`'s own comment says the
constant is for: *the dark face, just proud of the logs' own relief*. No shared helper
(`common/openings.py`, `logwork.py`, `mesh.py`, `emit.py`, `materials.py`), schema, recipe
scheme, camera, grade or match verdict was touched, and no other record states a set.

**Why nothing caught it, and what catches it now.** Every numeric check in
`tools/test_log_compound_apertures.py`, both smoke legs and the whole application review
passed on the striped build, because the fault lived in a depth no reading looks at. The
test now pins the invariant by reading the builder's own source — the surround's `back`
and the face's offset must be the same absolute offset, and that offset must exceed
`RELIEF_M`. Checked both ways: reverting the one expression makes it **FAIL** ("and the
dark face is given that same absolute offset (APERTURE_BACK_M)", 1 failure); restoring it
passes all 47 checks.

### Native rebuild — actually run, before the first source commit

Pinned Blender **4.5.3** on **Ubuntu 26.04.1 LTS**, cached tarball sha256 verified against
`generators/blender.pin` (`975c58fc…d845`) before use. All **82** `log_dwelling` masters
rebuilt in four bounded foreground batches (21/21/21/19 — 3 s, 2 s, 2 s, 1 s), then
`stale_derivatives.py` → `web_derivatives.sh --only` (16 s), `compile_scene.py --all`
(15 s), `generate_entrances.py`, `publish.sh` (57 s).

**81 of the 82 masters came back byte-identical**, so the option is still genuinely absent
for every other record. Only Cobweb's moved:

| | before (PR1690's striped output) | after |
|---|---|---|
| MASTER | `4f42207be5fcb2391fda58672ce8442b02aba9510f3096db8c2934b695fe7bea` (139 248 B) | `1ddf548d9a378167163d6db45e5d89e1b4c544ea176355eb7061dd99d6a1ee82` (139 248 B) |
| WEB | `1699d7aa1c4b0abb6229bd4cbfaed95013f3ede9323f4945396583fd14b26e23` (30 304 B) | `99997b5f3935ceceddb072286387859a5d9a8dd3dfa112b64978d1213e20890e` (30 304 B) |

`assets/manifest.json` moved in exactly 82 lines, all `inputs_sha256` — one per master,
which is what a producer edit does. `assets/manifest.web.json` moved in exactly **one**
line, Cobweb's. The six `versions/…` snapshots `stale_derivatives.py` listed re-derived
byte-identical. `data/enclosures/town_entrance_aprons.json` is **unchanged**: this moves a
depth, not a rectangle, so the grounded entrance and its apron keep the ground they held.
No foreign registry row was hand-won or stamped.

### The controlled pixels, at the same private camera

Re-run with `tools/photo_match.mjs` at the retained private camera `07f94fa8…` on source
`624d8f1f…`, only the GLB changing. Rendering the two *earlier* meshes reproduced the
review's own images **byte-for-byte** — `a893bf59…` for `af1f33c0` and `6f8bbb14…` for
`4f42207b`, and the 8× fixed crops `0c215929…` and `e2a70203…` likewise — which is what
makes the third render comparable rather than merely new. The repaired mesh renders
`fe496a9f…`.

**Both lower faces now read as uninterrupted dark upright recesses.** The upper gable
light, the casings, both wings' single windows, the two stacks, the roofs and the massing
are unchanged. That camera is **still UNSOLVED**, still unenrolled and still private: no
RMS, no From-this-spot link, no grade change, no `matches` verdict, no completion.

### Source gate — all four parts, each a bounded foreground call

`tools/check.sh --part k/4`, run **before** the first source commit, on the published tree:

| part | steps | time | verdict |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1/4 | 292 | 391 s | **PASS**, none red |
| 2/4 | 292 | 315 s | **PASS**, none red |
| 3/4 | 291 | 302 s | **PASS**, none red |
| 4/4 | 291 | 243 s | **PASS**, none red |

1 166 steps, none red. No step stood on a banked reading — numpy, scipy, Pillow, pyproj,
jsonschema, openpyxl and pypdf are all installed here, and the only "not installed" lines
in the transcripts are the tagged self-test proving that warning fires. Preflight's other
two questions, which `check.sh` cannot ask: `check-changelog-entry.mjs` against merge base
`22d624f3e` — entry present; `resolve_id_collisions.mjs --check` — not applicable, tickets
are their own repo.

**One environment-only change, and it is deliberate.** This runner ships NumPy 2.5.4,
which removed `np.cross` on 2-vectors (reproduced here directly; `socket_controls` uses
it). Per T-3368 that is an environment issue, so numpy was pinned to **2.3.5** to align
with CI — not worked around in source, and no assertion was bypassed.

### Smoke, by the parts that cover the diff

| leg | result |
|---|---|
| `SMOKE_VIEWPORT=mobile SMOKE_STAGE=3-4 … --published` | **SMOKE PASS** — 139 passed, 0 failed, 5 m 54 s |
| `SMOKE_VIEWPORT=desktop SMOKE_STAGE=3 … --published` | **SMOKE PASS** — 107 passed, 0 failed, 5 m 51 s |
| `SMOKE_VIEWPORT=mobile SMOKE_STAGE=1-2 … --published` | 193 passed, **5 failed** — see below |

**The five mobile 1-2 failures are dev's, not this PR's, and that was measured rather than
assumed.** All five are the Green Tree Tavern's yard: *the yard layer stands the record's
goods* (0 sheds, 80 frontages refused), the exact-owner rejections, the covered-wagon
bound, *the Green Tree's wagon shed is a lean-to that clears its tilt* (0 sheds, covered
wagon MISSING) and *nothing in the shed's bay reaches through its wall or its roof*. This
branch changes nothing in that neighbourhood — against `dev` it touches only
`data/enclosures/town_entrance_aprons.json`, `data/liberties.json`,
`data/reconstruction/name_pool_keys.json`, the Cobweb sidecar/record/source files, and
`generators/archetypes/{facade_openings,log_dwelling,log_dwelling_params}.py`; `renderers/`
is untouched and the only moved mesh is Cobweb's. So the same leg was run on a **pristine
`origin/dev` worktree**, published from that tree: **193 passed, 5 failed, the identical
five names.** Both readings are filed with `dev-smoke-state.mjs record` (this tree
`sha256:1d5c963082e572d5`, dev `sha256:38e8a9d3d4601689`). This is not hidden and it is not
mine; it belongs with T-2376/#1684. Nothing here is a missing-load error.

### Current dev, integrated into this same branch

Merged twice while this ran — first `22d624f3e` (T-3041), then `a5eee9a01` (T-2379 and a
changelog fold). Both conflicts were append-only files, resolved by keeping **both** sides
and re-deriving rather than hand-winning: `docs/LIBERTIES.md`, `docs/ROADMAP.md`,
`docs/STATUS.md` and `tools/step_isolation.json` keep dev's entries and this branch's
(995 liberties, both `L-cobweb-apertures-2374` and `L-first-fort-ne-house-pyramid-3041`
present; 871 isolation rows = dev's 870 plus this one), and `data/liberties.json`,
`data/sidecars/1835/sources/index.json` and `docs/measurements/source_use_coverage.md`
were regenerated by their own compilers (559 sources, 229 663 raw bytes, all IDs resolve).

That first integration is also why the hosted gate had nothing to say about
`ee8529e2c`: the PR was `dirty` against the newer dev, so GitHub could not build a merge
ref and never created a `pull_request` run. With dev merged the PR is `mergeable` again and
the **full eight-part `gate`** is running on this head.

### Still open — this is not a match

`T-2374` stays **OPEN / PARTIAL / DIFFERS** and is released back to the queue. The
panorama's camera is UNSOLVED and unenrolled; the compound's overall width, the wing and
sub-roof silhouettes, the roof junctions and valleys, the text-attested partial
clapboarding "part way up", and the building's finish and tone all still differ from the
picture. The source is retrospective 1831 context printed in 1881, not proof of the
building as it stood on 1835-07-01. No photo follow-up ticket, no split, no sign-off.

Receipts, including the pre-gate unqualified checkpoint saved before any long gate:
[`pr1690-exact-resume-depth-repair-wip-41766`](https://github.com/kevinrhaas/chicago-evidence/tree/main/evidence/cobweb-2026-11-04/pr1690-exact-resume-depth-repair-wip-41766).
The earlier striped images stay where they are as failed evidence.
